## Summary of Changes
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes.

- Fixes #(issue)
- Feature description:

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project style guidelines (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] I have tested this on Chrome, Firefox, and Safari
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly
